amendments.because: Starting the new release elsewhere changed how every client starts a release and still failed when the user's own shell sits in the worktree; the pull request is already merged, so the leftover folder is only cleanup
amendments.done_when: When the pin changes mid-run, Forge starts the new release from the main checkout, so forge merge and forge land run from inside an item's worktree can remove it on Windows

amendments.because: Git may delete part of the folder before the removal fails, so Forge should not claim it kept the worktree; a held-open folder on Windows cannot be reproduced on other OSes, and a refused removal stands in for it
amendments.done_when: When forge merge or forge land can't remove an item's worktree because another program still has it open, the merge finishes, keeps the worktree and its branch, and says so

amendments.because: forge doctor --fix finds finished work through git worktree list, so it cannot see a folder git already unregistered; deleting the folder is the instruction that works
amendments.done_when: When forge merge or forge land cannot finish removing an item's worktree after its pull request merged, the merge still finishes and exits 0, says the folder could not be fully removed, and tells the user to close any program using it and run forge doctor --fix

done_when: When forge merge or forge land cannot finish removing an item's worktree after its pull request merged, the merge still finishes and exits 0, keeps the local branch, says the folder could not be fully removed, and tells the user to close any program using it and delete the folder

findings.body: Raise: Not done — The failed-removal path exits 0 and says the folder could not be fully removed, but it tells the user to delete the folder instead of running `forge doctor --fix`. The changed guidance in `src/forge/templates/skill.md` and both host skills gives the same deletion instruction. This misses an explicit Done-when detail for both `forge merge` and `forge land`, which calls `merge.merge`.
findings.title: Not done: When forge merge or forge land cannot finish removing an item's worktree after its pull request merged, the merge still finishes,

findings.body: Raise: Test — The named command proof asserts that the output says to delete the folder, so it passes with the required `forge doctor --fix` instruction absent. The proof list also describes deletion rather than the Done-when instruction. The merge test therefore does not fail when this required user guidance breaks.
findings.title: Not done: test the required forge doctor --fix cleanup instruction

why: On Windows, forge merge or forge land run from inside an item's worktree stops with 'could not remove the worktree' when main's pinned release changes mid-run: the old forge processes keep the worktree folder open
